articles.body: Tennessee GOP Rep. Andy Ogles was ousted by a Republican challenger on Thursday, a blow to President Donald Trump and Speaker Mike Johnson who tried to boost his campaign in the final days. Former Tennessee Agriculture Commissioner Charlie Hatcher won the GOP primary for the 5th District after outraising Ogles, receiving a late endorsement from GOP Gov. Bill Lee and seeing a flood of outside money on his behalf from a renewable energy super PAC . Ultimately, that spending, coupled with a newly redrawn district that forced Ogles to reach new voters, helped end his reelection bid. Ogles has also faced a number of controversies since he was first elected in 2022. He deleted a homophobic social media post that was denounced by members of his own party in June, and he drew severe backlash for another post in which he said “Muslims don’t belong in American society.” In 2024, the FBI searched Ogles’ phone during an investigation into campaign finance records, which came after a watchdog group filed an ethics complaint into his use of campaign funds. And in 2023, he faced scrutiny for false claims about his resume. Ogles’ loss makes him the second Trump-endorsed candidate to lose a primary this week, after a Michigan House candidate who had the president’s backing fell to a challenger who had already dropped out . Hatcher will face the Democratic mayor of Columbia, Tennessee, Chaz Molder, in November. Molder has posted strong fundraising hauls, while Hatcher will basically be starting from scratch. But Republicans redrew the seat to favor Trump by 23 points after the Supreme Court severely limited the Voting Rights Act earlier this year, leaving Hatcher as the front-runner.
articles.headline: GOP Rep. Andy Ogles ousted in Tennessee primary

articles.body: HIDALGO, Texas — Bobby Pulido is learning that the bright lights of politics can be even harsher than music superstardom. For the past several months, the Latin Grammy-winning singer and local megacelebrity has been the subject of a steady stream of national headlines scrutinizing his former professional relationship with a one-time bandmate who was imprisoned on child sex molestation charges. He’s also faced criticism for past social media posts that included racial, sexist and homophobic slurs and comments. During a recent interview with POLITICO — after a weeknight meet-and-greet with voters in the same stadium where he performed his final concert in November 2025 — Pulido struck a defensive tone about the scandals that have plagued his campaign. “I apologize right now,” Pulido said, referring to the social media posts. “I'll tell you right now, that way you'll never ask me again. I apologize for everything that I've ever joked about that offended anybody. But I can't continue to revisit every single one.” Pulido also insisted he did nothing wrong in his working relationship with Frankie Caballero , maintaining he did not know about his former accordionist's child molestation charges. He expects opponents to “keep dripping, dripping, dripping, dripping” new social media posts. “I've been an open book for 30 years,” he said. “I was on Twitter way before I thought about running for office. They're gonna keep going to old tweets, and there's a lot of tweets in there that I'm embarrassed of. There's jokes that I've told that I apologize for, and I've owned up to them. I'm like, man, that makes me cringe, and I've publicly apologized.” Pulido is one of House Democrats’ prized battleground recruits and a key part of their plan to flip control of the lower chamber. The first-time candidate is widely known in Texas’ 15th District for his singing career, and he hopes to capitalize on voters’ anti-incumbency angst in his bid against GOP Rep. Monica De La Cruz in a newly redrawn district that President Donald Trump won by 18 points in 2024. Recent polling shows the race within the margin of error or Pulido leading , thanks in large part to his near-universal name ID. But while voters have shown a strong interest in political outsiders, those outsiders are also untested — and new revelations can swamp news cycles and potentially their chances. The New York Post first reported in April on Pulido’s past relationship to Caballero, a registered sex offender who was imprisoned for indecent contact with an eight-year-old girl. Pulido told POLITICO he first learned that Caballero was incarcerated on sex charges from the Post report, and Pulido’s campaign says the singer’s management company cut ties with Caballero after learning about a domestic abuse charge in 2021. Pulido said he’d asked Caballero why he was in prison. “Transferring illegal aliens. That's what he told me,” he told POLITICO. “And I knew he had a lot of substance abuse issues, and he violated a lot of his paroles. Those were the things that he told me.” (Pulido’s campaign told the Texas Tribune in July that Pulido only knew Caballero struggled with addiction.) In June, Axios reported Caballero performed with Pulido at a middle school benefit concert in 2018, where children were present, after being released from prison. When asked if he regretted having Caballero play there, Pulido said he did — knowing what he knows now. “Without me knowing, it's hard for me to say that,” he said. “Me, that I know now, yes. I wish I wouldn't have taken him there.” Caballero could not be reached for comment. Pulido’s past social media posts have also come back to haunt the singer-turned-politician. In Twitter posts between 2013 and 2018, Pulido used homophobic and sexist Spanish-language slurs which translate to “f-g,” “f----t” and “p---y.” In several other posts, he used the word “ prieto ,” a term referring to dark-skinned individuals many view as pejorative. The posts were first reported by NBC News and reviewed by POLITICO. In another 2013 Spanish-language post reviewed by POLITICO, Pulido joked that Mexican actor Mauricio Islas “isn’t a f-g, respect him. His boyfriend is.” Islas, whose partner is a woman, did not respond to a request for comment. Pulido told POLITICO some of the remarks were made in jest toward personal friends. “That's how we joke. I would never tell a stranger that,” he said. He defended his use of the racial term as a cultural misunderstanding. “In our culture, we call each other that. It’s like Black people calling each other the n-word,” he said. “Would somebody that called another Black person the n-word be accused of racism? But they want to come and translate what I said to this guy, which is how we say it and we're joking, they wanted to make it seem like I'm telling some complete stranger that. That's not what it is.” “I'm not making excuses,” Pulido added. “Would you have to apologize to your friend that you joke like that with, that doesn't have a problem with anything you say? I don't feel like I should have to apologize to them because they're my friends.” This isn’t the first time he’s flashed irritation when asked about his past posts, saying they distract from issues like affordability and immigration that voters care about. Pulido let loose on the New York Post when the paper reached out for comment about some other controversial social media posts . “We’ve been getting the same recycled tabloid nonsense since last October,” he said in a July video posted to his social media channels. “And for whatever reporter that wants to keep asking,” he said in Spanish, “ que no mamen, Kool-Aids. Now go translate that.” The colloquial phrase translates roughly to “don’t be jerks, assholes” or “don’t be stupid, assholes.” De La Cruz’s campaign hopes to make hay out of the issues. In a statement, James Shook, the representative’s campaign manager, said Pulido is a “product of the corrupt compadre system that looks out for itself and everybody else is expected to look away.” In press releases, De La Cruz’s campaign has pointed out apparent inconsistencies in Pulido’s statements. They note that Pulido told The Monitor he fired Caballero in 1996, but Caballero appears on two of Pulido’s albums through 1999. In a 2019 podcast, Pulido suggested he got Caballero out of jail; he told Bloomberg this year that was “hyperbolic” and he “misspoke.” "Bobby Pulido walked a man convicted of molesting an eight-year-old girl onto a middle school event in this community, and hid his sex offender status from parents,” Shook said. “This is someone he toured with for years and is on tape bragging he personally bailed him out of jail. The only question left is why he thought he would get away with it.” But there are signs that voters have become increasingly desensitized to scandal. A new POLITICO Poll found a significant share of voters — both Republican and Democrat — say they would stick with their preferred candidate even if they were caught accepting gifts from lobbyists, exploiting tax loopholes or making antisemitic posts. Democrats drew a harsher line when it came to accusations of sexual violence and sexual assault. Voters were not polled on past use of homophobic or gender slurs on social media, or on relationships with sex offenders. Some of Pulido’s supporters who know his family largely shrug off the headlines. Esmeralda Knapp, a hairstylist in McAllen, said she will vote for Pulido solely because his uncle, a former county judge, helped secure Knapp’s brother’s release from prison many years ago. Bob Villarreal, a retired teacher in Edinburg, reminisced about the time Pulido’s father, a musician himself, substitute-taught his sixth-grade orchestra class. Maria Dominguez, who runs a wellness club in McAllen, said Pulido is “a good person” because she knows his family: “His family are working people, good people and raised in the valley.” Villarreal brushed off Pulido’s relationship with Caballero. “It wasn’t Bobby,” he said. “I guess it's important for some people, but for me, I mean, it's somebody else.” “It’s guilt by association,” said Patricia Villarreal, his wife.
articles.headline: Bobby Pulido is sick and tired of apologizing

articles.body: The wave of populist energy propelling progressive Democrats to primary wins across the country reduced Wednesday morning to a ripple, just pushing Abdul El-Sayed to a narrow victory over his more moderate opponent, Rep. Haley Stevens. Francesca Hong will try to keep the progressive momentum alive in another swing-state test in Wisconsin next week. But if Hong, the democratic socialist frontrunner to claim her party’s gubernatorial nomination, wins her primary, she’s already recognizing the need to unite a broader coalition to win in November. “We absolutely need every single vote, and we’ll be fighting to earn every single vote,” Hong said in an exclusive interview with POLITICO on Wednesday morning. “I’ve talked to moderates and independents, Republicans, folks who don’t have a political home right now, and they have a lot of concerns about what's going on in the state. They also have concerns about things I've said in the past,” she added. “But what we’re focusing on is how to come together to actually deliver for Wisconsinites, and that’s going to be electing Democrats down and up the ballot this cycle.” Hong, a state Assembly member and former restaurant owner, this week faced criticism from across the political spectrum about a slew of old social media posts espousing far-left views, from declarations to abolish the police to a call to “cancel Thanksgiving.” And El-Sayed’s knife-edge win right next door is reigniting concerns among some Democrats that a battleground may not be ready for such a lefty leader. Hong appears to be moderating on — or at least adding context to — some of her more controversial positions. She has walked back her stance on police abolition while emphasizing the need to better tackle the underlying causes of crime. She told POLITICO many of her old posts were “jokes,” including the one about Thanksgiving, which she said is actually her favorite holiday. Still, Hong isn’t giving up her democratic socialist bonafides. “The vision that we have for Wisconsin is one that my local DSA chapter shares,” she said, adding that “we’re fighting to make sure that we're building the diverse coalition that we need to make sure that we win this for Wisconsinites in November.” Hong has notched endorsements from several national progressives, including Rep. Ro Khanna (D-Calif.) and Rep. Ilhan Omar (D-Minn.), who rallied alongside her and the progressive podcaster Hasan Piker last weekend. But she hasn’t been endorsed by the country’s two most prominent democratic socialists and standardbearers of the progressive movement: Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-Vt.) and Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (D-N.Y.). Hong told POLITICO she has not spoken to either and attributed their lack of endorsement to their focus on federal races — though Sanders endorsed Troy Jackson in the Vermont governor’s race before he lost and became the Senate nominee, and both endorsed New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani last year. “We have been focusing on winning a Democratic primary and staying above the drama,” Hong said. Despite a major fundraising disadvantage, Hong has emerged as an unlikely frontrunner. She has led in the polls for months and became the all-but-presumed nominee after her main opponents, Lt. Gov. Mandela Barnes and Lt. Gov. Sara Rodriguez , both dropped out amid simmering scandals that embroiled their campaigns. Hong’s chief primary opponent next week is Milwaukee County Executive David Crowley, who dropped out of the race then jumped back in last month and has the endorsement of the state’s current Gov. Tony Evers, a moderate Democrat. Whoever wins on Tuesday will face off against the President Donald Trump-endorsed GOP Rep. Tom Tiffany. Hong believes her lead is due to a grassroots campaign that has excited Democratic primary voters in Wisconsin. “Free child care, fully funding our schools, taxing the billionaires and a moratorium on AI data centers is what the majority of Wisconsinites have been telling us that they want, and we are the campaign that is listening,” she said in the interview. The Crowley campaign is pointing to the Michigan results as a sign that they can still catch Hong. “There is still a long way to go in this race,” Crowley spokesperson Eddie Vale said. “If you can't handle an easy CNN interview about Thanksgiving how can you possibly face the full wrath of the Republican attack machine?” To beat Tiffany in the general, Hong would likely need to pick up support from more moderate Democrats and independents — all while dodging a deluge of Republican attacks digging up her old comments and seeking to paint her as “woke.” “All Francesca Hong has to offer Wisconsin is bigger government, a plan to make Wisconsin the highest-taxed state in the nation, and a record of calling to abolish the police and prisons,” Tiffany said in a statement to POLITICO. “They are trying to get a head start on labeling her ahead of the primary because they don't see the result changing,” said Winnebago County Executive Gordon Hintz, who was minority leader in the state Assembly when Hong was first elected. “There’s a very big discussion going on in Wisconsin, much as there was in Michigan, about whether a very progressive candidate can prevail in the primary and in the general election,” said John Nichols, a Madison native who wrote an anti-capitalist manifesto with Sanders. “It goes to a lot of questions about what's been said in the past and how much people care.” Asked if she planned to change her messaging strategy ahead of the primary, Hong flipped the question back to Tiffany. “When it comes to tailoring messaging, it's important to recognize that what we have to offer are actual solutions, and what Tom Tiffany is bringing are clearly more Trump tariffs,” she said. Tiffany, in his statement, hit back. “While she focuses on promoting socialism, defending inflammatory statements, and campaigning alongside terrorist sympathizers, I'll remain focused on ending the 400-year property tax hike, rooting out fraud, bringing good-paying jobs back to Wisconsin, and making life more affordable after eight years under a Democrat governor,” he said. articles.body: President Donald Trump’s most vocal opponents on the right were sowing the seeds for a future third-party political organization during a weekend get-together aimed at undercutting the Republican establishment. The meeting at Tucker Carlson’s compound in Maine with Rep. Thomas Massie, former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene and others — captured in a photo posted by Greene on Saturday — served as a launch pad for a possible independent presidential campaign focused on unwinding U.S. involvement in foreign conflicts. “We said no more foreign wars and we meant it and supported Donald Trump because he made that promise. But he’s betrayed us all,” Greene wrote in the post. “The movement has begun.” Joe Kent, the former Trump national security official who resigned earlier this year and attended the weekend confab with Carlson, said the group congregated to strategize on how to best organize their shared opposition to the war in Iran. “There's a lot more nuts-and-bolts work that needs to be done there,” Kent said in an interview on “The Young Turks,” the progressive talk show. “Running as a third-party candidate is challenging. Not impossible, but it is very challenging. But that's kind of the consensus that we came to, that the current system just simply doesn't work, and we have to find something new to save our country.” Carlson, Greene and Massie all backed Trump ahead of the 2024 election. But each one broke with Trump over the course of his second term as the Trump administration continued to coordinate military operations with Israel in the Middle East. Greene and Massie were also loudly critical of Trump’s opposition to releasing federal investigative documents relating to convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, further drawing Trump’s ire. It’s unclear who would lead the newborn movement. Kent said every attendee at the Maine meeting urged Carlson to run for president in 2028 with their group’s backing but noted that Carlson said he wouldn’t run. “Hopefully he wakes up one day and Tucker says he's going to run,” Kent said. Carlson and Massie did not respond to requests for comment. Greene declined to comment. The challenges facing third-party and independent presidential candidates are enormous. They must navigate different signature requirements and deadlines in each state just to get on the ballot. Past independent campaigns have been unable to compete financially with the two major parties. The most recent third-party presidential campaign — Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s independent bid in 2024 — ended months before Election Day when Kennedy endorsed Trump. At the time he dropped out, Kennedy was polling in single digits and fighting lawsuits seeking to block him from the ballot in multiple states. Kent said the policy platform for the group’s hypothetical third-party campaign in 2028 would ignore most domestic matters and further emphasize their staunch anti-interventionism. “I think it is having a very, very simple platform, and it's acknowledging upfront, like, we are going to disagree on a lot of domestic policy and a lot of social issues,” Kent said. “At the end of the day, the president can talk a lot about all those things, but he really doesn't have a lot of power.” “We do agree that we don't want Israel dictating our foreign policy,” he added. “We don't want any more foreign wars.” Carlson didn't signal his involvement in any broader political project or back a third-party candidate for 2028 during his show Wednesday. Instead, he delivered an hour-long monologue laying out his worldview and aspirations for the country. His vision covered familiar territory — including encouraging Americans to have more children, ending immigration and promoting healthy foods. In addition to denouncing Trump, he called Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth a "deranged, bloodthirsty monkey," for his conduct during the Iran War. Lisa Kashinsky, Alec Hernandez and Sam Benson contributed to this story.
articles.headline: Anti-Trump conservatives Tucker Carlson, MTG, Massie huddle about launching third-party movement

articles.body: Abdul El-Sayed has just three months to convince a fractured Democratic Party to unite behind him after a nasty primary. Even before his narrow win over moderate Rep. Haley Stevens became official Wednesday , El-Sayed had begun the difficult process of trying to patch things up with a moderate wing of the party he’d spent months flaying as corporatist stooges as Republicans launched their first wave of attacks of the general election. He says he looks forward to “building relationships” with Jewish voters. And some top Democrats in Michigan and Washington alike are largely filing behind him in a show of unity ahead of November’s high-stakes election. “To all of our supporters here tonight, watching on TV, tomorrow we begin to mend fences,” El-Sayed told a crowd of supporters early Wednesday before the race was called, asking them to show “magnanimity in victory.” “We need to move forward and start bringing this party together,” El-Sayed reiterated on MS NOW’s Morning Joe hours later. And, in a speech formalizing his victory after it was called at 10 a.m. Eastern, he said: “Whatever differences that we might have had in the primary, they pale in comparison to what unifies us.” El-Sayed has little time to force a reconciliation before he faces off against Mike Rogers, a Donald Trump-endorsed former representative with the backing of Washington’s GOP Senate apparatus. Michigan is one of the nation’s top battlegrounds, a state Trump has won twice but where Democratic Sen. Elissa Slotkin narrowly defeated Rogers in 2024. Early voting begins in five weeks. Already prominent Michigan Democrats like Slotkin and Rep. Debbie Dingell are working to consolidate support behind El-Sayed, showing efforts from both the moderate and progressive flanks after a bitter primary that put tensions over Israel and campaign finance in the spotlight. “We do have to unite,” Dingell said in an interview. “Abdul’s got to figure out how he's going to bring people that were part of Haley's coalition and have them know that he cares about the values that they have, which I know he does, but he's got to talk to them. This coalition has got to be a very broad coalition.” Michigan Democrats plan to hold their so-called post-primary “unity breakfast” Thursday morning in Southfield, where they will rally behind party nominees. The contest was separated by less than a percentage point when the AP called the race Wednesday morning. Stevens immediately conceded and called for unity. And state Sen. Mallory McMorrow, who dropped her U.S. Senate bid a month before the primary, had already endorsed El-Sayed, saying she wanted to enter November “as a unified party” after “a brutal primary.” “We must elect Democrats up and down the ballot,” Stevens said in a statement Wednesday, promising her support to El-Sayed after calling her primary with him “a thorough and rigorous campaign that brought out the full span of views within the Democratic Party.” The primary was animated by charges of sexism, racism and religious bigotry. Splits over Israel played prominently in the race: El-Sayed attacked Stevens incessantly for relying on outside spending from groups like the American Israel Public Affairs Committee, which spent a record $32 million on her behalf. In the race’s final days, Stevens and her allies accused El-Sayed of antisemitism and sexism , and El-Sayed’s allies accused Stevens of Islamophobia . Outgoing Sen. Gary Peters (D-Mich.), who had endorsed Stevens, said he spoke with El-Sayed Wednesday morning and congratulated him. He said he will “work hard to make sure” Democrats coalesce behind El-Sayed. “The party has to all come together right now,” he told POLITICO. “We don't have a lot of time, but everybody has to come together and understand that as Democrats, whatever differences we have between us as Democrats are minor compared to the differences between our Democratic candidate and the Republican candidate.” Republicans are already plastering the airwaves with their preferred attack: Painting El-Sayed as “radical” and “dangerous” while emphasizing the full name of the American-born son of Egyptian immigrants. “Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed, the most radical Senate candidate in America,” a new National Republican Senatorial Committee ad says . “Abdul El-Sayed: Dangerously radical,” says a new Senate Leadership Fund ad. In a statement Wednesday morning, Rogers called El-Sayed an "extremist” who “campaigns with people who refuse to condemn terrorism” — likely a reference to comments made by his ally, far-left streamer Hasan Piker , which Piker has since said he regretted. “I spent years hunting terrorists and bringing Osama bin Laden to justice,” said Rogers, a former FBI special agent. “Never in a million years did I think that I would be running against someone who believes America deserved 9/11.” Cullen Schwarz, a longtime Democratic strategist in Michigan, said Democrats need to portray Rogers as the extreme one if they’re going to emerge victorious in the must-win Senate race. “As Democrats move forward, I hope we remember that in politics, the real battle is over moving the Overton window,” he said. “The Republicans are going to try to paint progressives across the country as extreme. It's extreme to support Donald Trump.” If that is the frame, Schwarz said, he doesn’t think Democrats will have any issues reunifying. “Democrats will immediately remember the fight we're facing in the fall,” he said. “There's been no force more unifying for Democrats than Donald Trump,” El-Sayed could have the most work to do in rural, working-class areas and among Black voters. He won just 34 percent of the vote in Detroit, according to unofficial returns. And Stevens won a majority of votes across counties where less than 30 percent of adults have a college degree, according to a POLITICO analysis. Matt Duss, a former foreign policy adviser to Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-Vt.), said Democrats — from Michigan to Washington — need to line up behind El-Sayed. “Frankly, the Democratic establishment needs to very quickly consolidate around him — all of them,” said Duss, executive vice president at Center for International Policy. “If they believe what they say about needing to take Michigan for Democrats in the Senate, they can show us by getting all in behind El-Sayed right now.” El-Sayed’s emergence from the contentious primary — which saw record levels of outside spending in one of the nation’s key battlegrounds — will require some Washington Democrats who previously kept him at arm’s length to now embrace him. Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer (D-N.Y.). said he preferred Stevens in the primary, but he released a statement Wednesday saying he and Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee Chair Kirsten Gillibrand “look forward to working with Abdul and Democrats across Michigan to win this seat in November.” And the narrow result is forcing progressives who had been expecting a dominant, double-digit victory to recalibrate their expectations as their attention shifts to the general. “Tough result for Democrats,” said Adrian Hemond, founder of a Michigan-based bipartisan advocacy and outreach firm. “The promised populist wave was a dud… If you think the primary was nasty, just wait until next week. General election voters are less college educated and less ideological, so they have to find a way to sell ideology to normal people.” Jessica Piper, Adam Wren, Ali Bianco and Mia McCarthy contributed reporting.
articles.headline: Messy Michigan primary leaves Democrats licking wounds

articles.body: President Donald Trump’s endorsed candidate lost a top battleground Republican primary in Michigan — to a candidate who suspended his campaign last month. Amir Hassan, a Navy veteran and former law enforcement officer from Flint backed by Trump, finished significantly behind Tom Smith on Wednesday. Hassan rallied with Trump in Milford, Michigan, just last week. Smith, a retired engineer, had dropped out in mid-July and endorsed another candidate who ended up in third in the primary. Smith told POLITICO that he would now return to challenge first-term Democratic Rep. Kristen McDonald Rivet for the purple 8th District. “I look forward to working with Speaker [Mike] Johnson and the entire Republican team to expand our House majority and advance President Trump’s America First agenda to lower costs for working families and make America affordable again,” Smith said in a statement. McDonald Rivet is among the more than a dozen Democratic incumbents seeking reelection in a district Trump won in 2024. But a GOP strategist, granted anonymity to speak candidly, characterized her as a “powerhouse.” The strategist added that Hassan had “clear flaws as a candidate” and the “GOP base was reluctant to support a dude named Amir Hassan.” A handful of Trump-endorsed candidates have lost state-level races this year — including the governor’s races in Iowa and Georgia — but Hassan is the first congressional candidate to lose despite the president’s support this cycle.
articles.headline: Trump-backed candidate in battleground Michigan district loses to opponent who dropped out

articles.body: Michigan Rep. Shri Thanedar lost his primary to democratic socialist Donavan McKinney on Wednesday — the latest victory for progressives who’ve been on a hot streak of ousting incumbents in safe-blue districts. Thanedar’s 13th District was a top priority for groups like Justice Democrats that are committed to primarying incumbent members that they believe aren’t in line with the areas they represent. Justice Democrats helped recruit McKinney into the race and spent nearly $1 million on his behalf, making his campaign one of its biggest targets this cycle. McKinney, a state representative, had secured the backing of a number of progressive House Democrats, including some members of the Congressional Black Caucus who bucked party leadership, which was standing behind Thanedar in the heavily Black Detroit-based district. Some of Thanedar’s colleagues were also frustrated by his efforts to force a vote on impeaching President Donald Trump last year, an effort he ultimately backed away from . The district is a safe seat for Democrats, and McKinney is expected to win easily in November.

articles.body: <p>Alejandro arropó con su chaquetón al bebé de cabello rizado que acababan de recoger de un flotador en Ceuta. El niño, vestido con su ropa infantil, estaba envuelto con papel film, como el que se utiliza para envolver bocadillos. “Solo le quedaba libre la cabecita”, recuerda. “Estaba afectado por el frío, no reaccionaba y comenzaba a echar espuma por la boca”. La madre estaba hecha un manojo de nervios. El pequeño, de tres años, fue rescatado junto a su madre, embarazada, y su padre a las 7 de la mañana del pasado jueves, apenas <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-30/otra-manana-de-centenares-de-entradas-de-inmigrantes-a-ceuta-pone-en-jaque-a-la-ciudad-autonoma.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-30/otra-manana-de-centenares-de-entradas-de-inmigrantes-a-ceuta-pone-en-jaque-a-la-ciudad-autonoma.html">unas horas antes de que se produjera la gran entrada masiva en Ceuta</a>. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-07/las-manos-que-salvaron-a-los-nadadores-en-la-frontera-de-ceuta-sacar-a-un-bebe-y-a-una-familia-es-una-alegria.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

Tras las <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-03/marruecos-niega-presiones-y-chantajes-en-la-crisis-de-ceuta.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-03/marruecos-niega-presiones-y-chantajes-en-la-crisis-de-ceuta.html">explicaciones oficiales de los Ministerios de Interior</a> y Asuntos Exteriores, en las que el Gobierno de Rabat limita a 11 el número de fallecidos en Marruecos durante la avalancha migratoria, partidos de la oposición islamista y de izquierdas exigen una investigación de la tragedia cuando se cumple una semana de la crisis fronteriza con España. ONG españolas y marroquíes estiman que la cifra de muertos en territorio marroquí se eleva a más de 60, frente a las entre 72 y 88 manejadas por fuentes oficiales en la ciudad autónoma española. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-08-07/la-crisis-migratoria-de-ceuta-abre-grietas-entre-los-partidos-de-marruecos-que-exigen-una-investigacion-por-las-muertes.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

Sin duda quedan <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-03/los-servicios-de-inteligencia-concluyen-que-rabat-permitio-y-utilizo-la-oleada-humana-sobre-ceuta-pero-no-la-planeo.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-03/los-servicios-de-inteligencia-concluyen-que-rabat-permitio-y-utilizo-la-oleada-humana-sobre-ceuta-pero-no-la-planeo.html">muchas cosas por aclarar,</a> muchas sombras de un singular acontecimiento en territorios procelosos. Los servicios de inteligencia españoles –el propio ministro del Interior, fernando Grande-Marlaska ha dicho que no se enteraron de nada- deberían dar explicaciones de un fracaso incomprensible. Y la facilidad con la que se ha impuesto la idea de que las autoridades marroquíes desconocían por completo lo que iba a ocurrir es por lo menos sospechosa. Signo de una cierta debilidad de España y de Europa que se han sumado rápidamente a la validación del Gobierno de Marruecos que el presidente del Gobierno español, <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-31/sanchez-denuncia-una-violacion-de-la-integridad-territorial-de-espana-tras-la-llegada-de-miles-de-inmigrantes-irregulares-a-ceuta.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-31/sanchez-denuncia-una-violacion-de-la-integridad-territorial-de-espana-tras-la-llegada-de-miles-de-inmigrantes-irregulares-a-ceuta.html">Pedro Sánchez, elevó a categoría</a> desde el primer momento. Sombras que se acumulan. Y que hacen difícil mantener la confianza en los gobernantes.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/opinion/2026-08-07/europa-y-el-espejismo-ceuti.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

"></img><p>A diferencia de otras crisis, <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-05/la-audiencia-nacional-pregunta-a-la-guardia-civil-si-tuvo-alguna-informacion-que-pudiese-alertar-de-la-entrada-masiva-en-ceuta.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-05/la-audiencia-nacional-pregunta-a-la-guardia-civil-si-tuvo-alguna-informacion-que-pudiese-alertar-de-la-entrada-masiva-en-ceuta.html">la avalancha migratoria de Ceuta</a> no puede tener otro responsable que el Gobierno, que dirige la política exterior y la defensa del Estado. Es un episodio de extrema gravedad que exige explicaciones detalladas de <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-04/marlaska-insiste-en-que-el-cni-no-alerto-de-una-llegada-masiva-de-migrantes-a-ceuta.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-04/marlaska-insiste-en-que-el-cni-no-alerto-de-una-llegada-masiva-de-migrantes-a-ceuta.html">los servicios de inteligencia, Interior y Defensa.</a> La democracia española dio una impresión de descoordinación y fragilidad, y dejó desatendidos a sus ciudadanos. España <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-31/sanchez-denuncia-una-violacion-de-la-integridad-territorial-de-espana-tras-la-llegada-de-miles-de-inmigrantes-irregulares-a-ceuta.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-31/sanchez-denuncia-una-violacion-de-la-integridad-territorial-de-espana-tras-la-llegada-de-miles-de-inmigrantes-irregulares-a-ceuta.html">denunció la violación de su integridad territorial,</a> pero cautelosamente no señaló quién cometía la agresión. Nadie lo hizo, salvo vaporosas mafias, desinformación, entusiastas <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-30/el-supremo-determino-que-las-devoluciones-en-caliente-no-se-pueden-aplicar-a-quienes-entren-a-nado-en-ceuta-y-melilla.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-30/el-supremo-determino-que-las-devoluciones-en-caliente-no-se-pueden-aplicar-a-quienes-entren-a-nado-en-ceuta-y-melilla.html">lectores de sentencias del Tribunal Supremo.</a> Y, al parecer, nadie debía estar vigilando. En palabras del ministro del Interior, que hace mucho que demostró no estar a la altura de su cargo: “No necesariamente tiene que haber una responsabilidad”. El universo es ciego, las cosas pasan. O, por decirlo con un estilo a la vez kafkiano y presidencial: “72.000 personas han entrado ilegalmente en Ceuta. Por la tarde, fui a nadar”.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/opinion/2026-08-06/notas-sobre-ceuta.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>Pedro Sánchez ha catado <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-04/los-socios-de-la-ue-rebajan-las-criticas-a-espana-por-la-crisis-de-ceuta-y-le-muestran-ahora-su-total-solidaridad.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-04/los-socios-de-la-ue-rebajan-las-criticas-a-espana-por-la-crisis-de-ceuta-y-le-muestran-ahora-su-total-solidaridad.html">el giro europeo en inmigración.</a> Parece ya evidente que <a href="https://elpais.com/economia/2026-08-04/la-regularizacion-impulsa-el-empleo-en-julio-y-espana-gana-41727-afiliaciones.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/economia/2026-08-04/la-regularizacion-impulsa-el-empleo-en-julio-y-espana-gana-41727-afiliaciones.html">la regularización masiva de inmigrantes</a> no sentó bien en varios países, y que <a href="https://elpais.com/opinion/2026-08-05/marruecos-cuestion-europea.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/opinion/2026-08-05/marruecos-cuestion-europea.html">el episodio de Ceuta</a> solo ha sido la excusa para protestar de forma soterrada. <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-05/ceuta-y-la-ue-la-feria-de-las-hipocresias.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-05/ceuta-y-la-ue-la-feria-de-las-hipocresias.html">El Gobierno podrá indignarse, pero Europa se ceba con quienes actúan a su aire.</a> Esta vez los socios comunitarios solo presionaron para que nuestro país actúe con mayor dureza en su frontera, quizás sospechando que ha hecho lo contrario.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/opinion/2026-08-06/pedro-sanchez-choca-con-una-ue-antinmigracion.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Pedro Sánchez choca con una UE antinmigración

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/66Y5KER55JBNDCEYOLJZYMT7N4.jpg?auth=362e634780aad652a77ece4634ed5e339c01d3d2accacdeea4f278bf1eaacf66" width="2362" height="2339" alt="."></img><p>Que la unión hace la fuerza es un proverbio de rancio abolengo, cuyas raíces clásicas pueden rastrearse en la<i> Ilíada</i>, <a href="https://elpais.com/cultura/2015/08/14/babelia/1439562665_225234.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/cultura/2015/08/14/babelia/1439562665_225234.html">en el empeño de alentar a los aqueos a cooperar en el campo de batalla para lograr la victoria sobre los troyanos.</a> Con el tiempo, se ha ido plasmando en los escudos de armas de muy distintos países mostrando siempre con ello un punto de nobleza. Pero también ha venido a convertirse en algo más cotidiano, en una perogrullada, palabra esta que tiene su origen en ese personaje popularizado por Quevedo <a href="https://www.rae.es/dpd/Perogrullo" target="_self" rel="" title="https://www.rae.es/dpd/Perogrullo">—Perogrullo—</a> que, al parecer, recitaba de forma sentenciosa verdades absolutas, pero completamente obvias. Según la RAE, una perogrullada es “una verdad o certeza que, por notoriamente sabida, es necedad o simpleza decirla”. Y seguro que es así.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/opinion/2026-08-06/la-union-hace-la-fuerza.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: La unión hace la fuerza

articles.body: <p>La ministra de Juventud e Infancia, Sira Rego (52 años, Valencia) ha llegado a Ceuta este jueves para gestionar una de las <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/ultima-hora-de-la-entrada-de-inmigrantes-a-ceuta-en-directo.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/ultima-hora-de-la-entrada-de-inmigrantes-a-ceuta-en-directo.html">mayores crisis migratorias de España</a>. Rego ha atendido a EL PAÍS por teléfono y anuncia que el traslado de los menores migrantes a las comunidades autónomas se hará en “unas semanas”. Reconoce que todavía no tiene cifras de cuántos niños y adolescentes han llegado a la ciudad autónoma y critica la gestión política del PP y Vox en las últimas horas.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/sira-rego-ministra-de-infancia-es-lamentable-que-pp-y-vox-hagan-un-uso-propagandistico-y-electoral-de-ceuta.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Sira Rego, ministra de Infancia: “Es lamentable que PP y Vox hagan un uso propagandístico y electoral de Ceuta”

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/VGB4RFAY5NFGFN33A24YMBZO4Q.jpg?auth=bf10343fcb1d8f1fa5df42ba9bd92d707e4c5532737d1014377aa15730eb56a4" width="1189" height="670" alt="Imagen de las cámaras de seguridad del comisario de policía Emilio de la Calle paseando frente a la vivienda de su subalterna en Nueva Dehli (India)"></img><p>“Me quedan ocho meses para putearte y eso se me da muy bien” o “te dejo como un trozo de carne, te reviento, ten cuidado”, son algunas de las frases que Sandra (nombre ficticio elegido para proteger su identidad) grabó en boca de su jefe, el comisario de la Policía Emilio de la Calle (actualmente suspendido) en la embajada de Nueva Delhi (India), entre 2024 y 2025. El juez de la Audiencia Nacional, Francisco de Jorge, que investiga al mando policial por delitos de acoso sexual y laboral, ha pedido que esta agente, que tuvo que someterse a tratamiento psicológico tras lo ocurrido, entregue el teléfono móvil con el que realizó estas grabaciones que forman parte del procedimiento judicial <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-02-27/los-audios-del-horror-un-comisario-de-la-policia-investigado-por-acoso-a-una-subordinada-en-la-india-que-hago-te-pego-a-ver-si-con-el-ojo-morado.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-02-27/los-audios-del-horror-un-comisario-de-la-policia-investigado-por-acoso-a-una-subordinada-en-la-india-que-hago-te-pego-a-ver-si-con-el-ojo-morado.html">y que desveló EL PAÍS.</a> Su defensa, sin embargo, ha recurrido esta decisión recordando al magistrado que ella es la víctima y que el propio comisario no puso en cuestión estas grabaciones durante su declaración. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-07/la-policia-que-acusa-de-acoso-sexual-y-laboral-el-comisario-de-la-india-rechaza-que-el-juez-tenga-acceso-a-su-movil.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: La Policía que acusa de acoso sexual y laboral al comisario de La India rechaza que el juez tenga acceso a su móvil

articles.body: <p>Vox no romperá sus pactos de gobierno con el PP en Extremadura, Aragón, Castilla y León y Andalucía <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/el-pp-reconoce-que-acogera-a-los-menores-en-sus-comunidades-el-partido-popular-siempre-cumple-la-ley-en-esta-ocasion-tambien.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/el-pp-reconoce-que-acogera-a-los-menores-en-sus-comunidades-el-partido-popular-siempre-cumple-la-ley-en-esta-ocasion-tambien.html">aunque estas comunidades autónomas acepten el reparto de los más de 1.100 menores extranjeros no acompañados </a>llegados a Ceuta, que desbordan con creces la capacidad de acogida de la ciudad autónoma. El partido ultra no protagonizará <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2024-07-11/vox-rompe-los-pactos-con-el-pp-y-pasa-a-la-oposicion-en-las-cinco-autonomias-donde-cobernaba.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2024-07-11/vox-rompe-los-pactos-con-el-pp-y-pasa-a-la-oposicion-en-las-cinco-autonomias-donde-cobernaba.html">una nueva espantada como la que dio en julio de 2024, </a>cuando salió de todos los gobiernos de coalición con el PP, a pesar de que sus pactos mencionan expresamente este asunto, que no figuraba en los de aquella época. “No más menores extranjeros no acompañados (MENA). Rechazo frontal a la política inmigratoria del Gobierno central y a la llegada de más inmigrantes ilegales, tanto mayores como menores de edad”, se lee en todos los acuerdos suscritos por PP y Vox.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/vox-no-rompera-los-gobiernos-autonomicos-con-el-pp-aunque-acepten-el-reparto-de-menores-extranjeros.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Vox no romperá los gobiernos autonómicos con el PP aunque acepten el reparto de menores extranjeros

articles.body: <p>La pregunta planea cada rueda de prensa que ofrece un dirigente del Partido Popular desde el jueves pasado, <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/las-patrullas-vecinales-alientan-brotes-de-violencia-contra-los-inmigrantes-en-barrios-de-ceuta.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/las-patrullas-vecinales-alientan-brotes-de-violencia-contra-los-inmigrantes-en-barrios-de-ceuta.html">cuando 72.000 personas entraron a Ceuta</a>. ¿Acogerán las comunidades, en su mayoría gobernadas por el PP, a los menores llegados aquel día? ¿Y aquellas que comparten el Ejecutivo con Vox después de haber firmado acuerdos en los que se oponen precisamente a su tutela? En el inicio de la crisis, Alberto Núñez Feijóo esquivó la cuestión cuando compareció desde la ciudad autónoma. “Conocen nuestro plan de inmigración”, respondió con evasivas el líder del PP, el sábado. Cinco días después, Génova reconoce que sus autonomías realojarán a los niños y menores extranjeros, aunque los barones protesten y se opongan con todo tipo de trabas al considerar que el reparto obligatorio es injusto. “El Partido Popular siempre cumple la ley; en esta ocasión, también. Nosotros y nuestros gobiernos”, ha asumido el vicesecretario de Política Autonómica y Municipal, Elías Bendodo, este jueves. <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/la-acogida-de-menores-por-la-crisis-de-ceuta-pone-a-prueba-los-pactos-de-pp-y-vox-en-las-comunidades.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/la-acogida-de-menores-por-la-crisis-de-ceuta-pone-a-prueba-los-pactos-de-pp-y-vox-en-las-comunidades.html">La norma obliga a darles cobijo cuando otro territorio exceda</a> por tres su capacidad de atenderles, como es el caso de Ceuta. Y “cumplir la ley” implica aceptar ese reparto.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/el-pp-reconoce-que-acogera-a-los-menores-en-sus-comunidades-el-partido-popular-siempre-cumple-la-ley-en-esta-ocasion-tambien.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: El PP reconoce que acogerá a los menores en sus comunidades: “El Partido Popular siempre cumple la ley, en esta ocasión, también”

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/6VLMEIVUHZHV7GB32MU4AL576U.jpg?auth=ffc1ea96d631bb39505128e03600a76ecd5499392c01532189ffac751ed5bec4" width="3648" height="2432" alt="Menores y familias coviven en el poligono del Tarajal"></img><p><a href="https://elpais.com/noticias/crisis-migratoria/" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/noticias/crisis-migratoria/">La entrada de 72.000 migrantes por la frontera de Ceuta</a> ha dejado una imagen insólita en el Congreso: Vox y Sumar han presentado sendas propuestas que buscan que se estudie la exclusión de Marruecos de la organización del Mundial 2030. Este jueves, el partido de Abascal ha registrado una proposición en la Cámara baja solicitando que la Comisión de Deportes discuta su exclusión como país coorganizador, mientras que <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-05/sumar-pide-al-gobierno-que-revise-el-acuerdo-del-mundial-2030-para-que-espana-ya-no-lo-organice-con-marruecos.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-05/sumar-pide-al-gobierno-que-revise-el-acuerdo-del-mundial-2030-para-que-espana-ya-no-lo-organice-con-marruecos.html">la coalición izquierdista ya había registrado un documento similar un día antes</a>. Además, fuentes del partido de ultraderecha señalan que estarían dispuestos a apoyar la propuesta de Sumar si esta “llegase a pleno o a comisión”.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/vox-y-sumar-coinciden-al-pedir-que-se-excluya-a-marruecos-de-la-organizacion-del-mundial-2030.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>Los cuatro últimos pactos de gobierno de PP y Vox en las comunidades <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-06-06/vox-se-hace-ya-con-las-competencias-sobre-los-menores-migrantes-no-acompanados-en-tres-comunidades-tras-las-cesiones-del-pp.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-06-06/vox-se-hace-ya-con-las-competencias-sobre-los-menores-migrantes-no-acompanados-en-tres-comunidades-tras-las-cesiones-del-pp.html">donde se han celebrado elecciones comparten</a> un mismo punto. “No más menores no acompañados”. Así lo acordaron ambas formaciones en Extremadura, Aragón, Castilla y León y Andalucía. En el resto de territorios donde los populares mandan en solitario, además, la resistencia a acoger más niños y jóvenes extranjeros es total bajo el pretexto de que los recursos están ya desbordados, y también con los ultras presionando desde la derecha. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/la-acogida-de-menores-por-la-crisis-de-ceuta-pone-a-prueba-los-pactos-de-pp-y-vox-en-las-comunidades.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p><img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/2C76VUH4SNABLNB6TW2QDWU3YE.jpg?auth=5882ee3792b8f4b963da0cda6bef1b4b87c31af1f69915742dfa91ed61fe7880" width="3577" height="2012" alt="El presidente de la Junta de Andalucía, Juan Manuel Moreno, y el líder de Vox andaluz y hoy vicepresidente, Manuel Gavira, el 4 de julio en Sevilla."></img>
articles.headline: La acogida de menores por la crisis de Ceuta pone a prueba los pactos de PP y Vox en las comunidades

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/XFO4HMB6LZC35KEBQ2PSL7H2NY.jpg?auth=6efc5f08aab51adb7e26313b864baacc856d1cbb007e52f4f01ab13c2f467fcf" width="4608" height="3456" alt="Menores en el centro de Piniers, en Ceuta, este miércoles."></img><p>Ceuta, Melilla y Canarias han trasladado a la Península más de 1.750 menores extranjeros no acompañados desde que se aprobó el reparto solidario por comunidades en agosto del año pasado, según datos de la Administración General del Estado. El mecanismo puesto en marcha en aquel entonces ha seguido su curso a pesar de las alegaciones y recursos presentados. En la actualidad, el sistema está detenido en Ceuta por la crisis migratoria que atraviesa la ciudad, donde el Gobierno ceutí asegura que <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-03/el-gobierno-de-ceuta-acondiciona-dos-grandes-instalaciones-para-reubicar-a-los-862-menores-migrantes-que-atiende-tras-la-crisis.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-03/el-gobierno-de-ceuta-acondiciona-dos-grandes-instalaciones-para-reubicar-a-los-862-menores-migrantes-que-atiende-tras-la-crisis.html">atiende a 1.200.</a> A mediados de julio, la localidad ya había dado la alarma de que el número de menores que estaban llegando a sus costas a nado había multiplicado de nuevo su capacidad de acogida. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/mas-de-1750-menores-extranjeros-han-sido-derivados-desde-canarias-ceuta-y-melilla-en-un-ano.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Más de 1.750 menores extranjeros han sido derivados desde Canarias, Ceuta y Melilla en un año

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/M6G7CSGQIFBWNCG2ALYGB6PJXQ.jpg?auth=13f61f41b3d719cbb90443fdb6048546e6e67a9a8a6070acdfe32f260a9be263" width="2000" height="1328" alt="Frontera hispano-marroquí de Ceuta en 2005."></img><p>Ceuta es tierra rara. Rara porque es Europa, pero está en África; porque uno puede nadar del mar al océano; porque en ella conviven en armonía no tres, sino cuatro culturas: musulmana, cristiana, hebrea e hindú. Así rezaba la campaña publicitaria que el año pasado animaba al turismo a visitar el curioso e inexplorado enclave español cuya frontera con Marruecos en el Tarajal explotó la semana pasada con el cruce de <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-30/otra-manana-de-centenares-de-entradas-de-inmigrantes-a-ceuta-pone-en-jaque-a-la-ciudad-autonoma.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-30/otra-manana-de-centenares-de-entradas-de-inmigrantes-a-ceuta-pone-en-jaque-a-la-ciudad-autonoma.html">más de 70.000 personas, </a>originando una crisis humanitaria que acabó con decenas de muertos bajo el agua. La ciudad aún no recobra el pulso, pero el espigón que divide los territorios ya se ha prolongado <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-01/el-gobierno-despliega-una-barrera-flotante-en-la-frontera-de-ceuta-para-cumplir-la-sentencia-del-supremo.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-01/el-gobierno-despliega-una-barrera-flotante-en-la-frontera-de-ceuta-para-cumplir-la-sentencia-del-supremo.html">en una barrera flotante de medio kilómetro</a>. Más puertas al mar que acartonan la fluida relación que en otros tiempos tuvieron a un lado y otro de la raya, cuando no se sellaba ni el pasaporte, dicen los que añoran aquellos tiempos en que el domingo se pasaba a Marruecos a comprar el pan y los dulces y los marroquíes entraban a España y salían cargados de cualquier cosa que cupiera bajo las mantas que se echaban a la espalda. La pandemia de coronavirus cerró las puertas de par en par en 2020, dando el golpe de gracia a un trasiego comercial, social y cultural que ya venía dañado, entre otras cosas por las entradas migratorias. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/ocaso-en-la-frontera-de-la-buena-vecindad-entre-ceuta-y-marruecos.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Ocaso en la frontera de la buena vecindad entre Ceuta y Marruecos

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/ZVNNL3FUERE3VCDABTHJC37OC4.jpg?auth=de4bcfa9aa597859113f8c67bdf4f34cce9a8553f67412ccd2fd58198d8a7c3a" width="4422" height="2495" alt="Dos hombres armados con un cuchillo (izquierda) y un palo siguen en Ceuta a un grupo de inmigrantes hacia la frontera con Marruecos el pasado día 31."></img><p>Sandra López, secretaria de Política Institucional del PSOE de <a href="https://elpais.com/noticias/ceuta/" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/noticias/ceuta/">Ceuta,</a> se tropezó el pasado sábado por la tarde con un grupo de inmigrantes cuando paseaba con su perro por los alrededores de la pista de tiro. Uno de ellos le preguntó en un español balbuceante ayudado con sus expresivos gestos la forma de llegar a la barriada ceutí de Benzú. Se llamaba Adil y tenía unos 25 años. Ella le señaló el camino más corto, atravesando la zona de Postigo. Él se negó en redondo. Ante la insistencia de ella, que no entendía su resistencia a seguir las indicaciones que le daba, él acabó por levantarse la ropa y mostrarle el cuerpo. Le enseñó arañazos en las piernas y el torso y, sobre todo, heridas, alguna profunda, en el brazo izquierdo, huellas de los golpes que, según le contó, había recibido en ese barrio. Ella fotografió las lesiones con su móvil y le preguntó por qué no denunciaba lo sucedido a la policía. Él lo descartó. Tenía miedo de que si acudía a comisaría sería detenido y expulsado de Ceuta. Tanto Adil como sus compañeros comenzaron a caminar hacia Benzú, dando un rodeo de varios kilómetros para eludir a los supuestos agresores.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-06/las-patrullas-vecinales-alientan-brotes-de-violencia-contra-los-inmigrantes-en-barrios-de-ceuta.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Las patrullas vecinales alientan brotes de violencia contra los inmigrantes en barrios de Ceuta

articles.body: <p>Felipe VI recibirá este jueves en el palacio de Marivent al presidente de la ciudad autónoma de Ceuta, Juan José Vivas, donde la Familia Real pasa sus vacaciones, según informó este miércoles por la tarde la Casa del Rey. La audiencia, que no estaba prevista, se produce justo una semana después de que el pasado 30 de julio una marea humana, integrada por 72.000 personas, según el último recuento oficial, irrumpiera irregularmente en la ciudad autónoma a través del paso del Tarajal.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-05/el-rey-recibira-en-mallorca-al-presidente-de-ceuta-una-semana-despues-de-la-avalancha-migratoria.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>“El fútbol no puede servir para blanquearlo todo”, sostiene Movimiento Sumar en un documento enviado al Congreso de los Diputados en el que insta al Gobierno a revisar <a href="https://elpais.com/noticias/mundial-2030/?rel=buscador_temas" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/noticias/mundial-2030/?rel=buscador_temas">la organización conjunta de España y Portugal con Marruecos del Mundial 2030</a>. articles.body: El periple dels veïns i comerciants de Sant Gervasi – la Bonanova continua. Ara fa tot just un mes que va aparèixer l’esvoranc de vuit metres arran de les obres de la Línia 9 del metro . I molts dels afectats encara en pateixen les conseqüències. Alguns d’ells han explicat a betevé que fa dies que viuen amb nervis per si la situació s’allarga en el temps. En total, es van desallotjar prop de 300 persones per deixar pas als tècnics, que van començar a revisar totes les finques per assegurar que no corrien cap risc. A mesura que han avançat les inspeccions, la Generalitat ha donat el vistiplau perquè veïns i comerciants de tres edificis retornin a casa . Ara bé, alguns d’ells continuen dormint en un altre lloc per por que hi hagi més incidents i pel soroll dels treballs dels operaris . Un d’aquests afectats és Josep Maria Olivé, veí de Rubinstein, 2 que demana una auditoria externa que garanteixi la seguretat de l’edifici. “Els que ens diuen que podem tornar a casa són els mateixos que van tirar endavant les obres del metro. Ens dona molta desconfiança “, ha afegit. Imatges de l’interior La zona zero de l’esvoranc de l’L9: així està ara el lloc del forat de vuit metres Lola Santiago Maria Solans 1 minut de lectura El 40 % dels veïns continuen desallotjats Tot i que alguns afortunats ja han pogut tornar a casa, encara hi ha molts desallotjats . És el cas dels veïns del número 54 de Sant Gervasi de Cassoles, que en un principi podran ser a casa aquesta mateixa setmana . Un cop ho facin, ja hauran retornat el 60 % dels afectats. El 40 % restant , les famílies i comerciants dels quatre edificis més propers a la zona zero de l’esvoranc, hauran d’esperar com a mínim fins al setembre . El motiu: s’ha detectat una altra cavitat i esquerdes estructurals en un d’aquests blocs. Per això, alguns d’ells demanen més respostes . “Al principi ens van dir que tornaríem a principis d’agost, ara parlen de setembre, segur que això s’acabarà allargant encara més “, comenta Ramón Pedrol, veí de Teodora Lamadrid, 5. Té 86 anys i fa un mes que viu en un hotel del barri amb la seva dona, Teresa Miró, qui confessa tenir moltes ganes de tornar a casa . “Ho estic desitjant”, diu. La història d’una parella desallotjada Viure en un hotel amb 86 anys, després de l’esvoranc de l’L9: “Ens fa falta estar a casa” Lola Santiago 2 minuts de lectura Els negocis han de fer front a les pèrdues econòmiques Els veïns no són els únics que han de fer front a aquest malestar. Els comerciants també són víctimes d’aquesta situació. Per exemple, Domingo Finez, propietari de la Pizzeria Verona , on va aparèixer l’esvoranc, confessa que fa dies que té malsons . “Somio que em cau el sostre del restaurant a sobre”. A més, assegura estar molt preocupat per la seva situació econòmica. “ He perdut molts diners i encara espero la indemnització del govern i una resposta de les assegurances”, ha afegit. Les repercussions econòmiques Front comú d’alguns dels afectats per l’esvoranc de les obres de l’L9 per reclamar indemnitzacions Andrea Muñoz Maria Solans 1 minut de lectura No és l’únic. Els efectes de l’esvoranc també recauen sobre els altres 15 negocis afectats , així com a algunes botigues del barri que, malgrat estar obertes, han perdut facturació aquests dies. Isabel Torres, propietària de la Tintoreria Torres, explica que ha disminuït la clientela perquè molts tenen por a apropar-se a la zona o perquè és molt incòmode accedir-hi. “Això serà un abans i un després per a tots”, diu. Primeres investigacions Els tècnics continuen treballant sobre el terreny per estabilitzar la situació i garantir la seguretat de tots els edificis. Tot plegat, mentre les causes de l’incident continuen sent una incògnita . La primera hipòtesi de la Generalitat és que no es va injectar prou formigó a la cavitat que va provocar l’esfondrament. En qualsevol cas, insisteixen que la investigació continua en marxa . articles.body: Un cop acabat el termini del procés extraordinari de regularització de migrants el 30 de juny , ara s’ha engegat el període per esmenar els errors en la documentació requerida. Per això, Correus ha habilitat 13 oficines a Barcelona per atendre aquelles persones que van fer la sol·licitud del procés de regularització en termini i necessiten aportar documentació addicional per tramitar el seu expedient. Aquest període d’esmena va començar l’1 de juliol i acabarà el 30 de setembre , últim dia en què les oficines postals estaran obertes per tramitar aquesta documentació. Ara, a l’agost , 11 de les oficines fan un horari de 8.30 a 14.30 h i només dues atenen de tarda, entre les 14.30 i les 17.30 h . Durant el mes de setembre totes atendran en horari de matí i tarda . També et pot interessar L’Ajuntament de Barcelona ha atès 87.000 persones en el procés de regularització d’immigrants Marina Segura i Vidal Marta Casals Torres 2 minuts de lectura Presencial i sense cita prèvia L’aportació de documentació addicional s’ha de fer de manera presencial a l’oficina i no cal cita prèvia . Entre les gestions que es poden fer, els sol·licitants poden afegir més documentació per iniciativa pròpia , per tal d’ampliar informació o com a resposta a un requeriment per rectificar documentació incorrecta, incompleta o que no es va aportar en el seu moment. En total, Correus ha habilitat 53 oficines a tot Catalunya per rebre i gestionar aquesta documentació addicional, la majoria (46) a la demarcació de Barcelona, però també a les altres tres demarcacions catalanes.

articles.body: Per relaxar-se i desconnectar hi ha dues opcions: o quedar-se a la vora d’on un viu per no gastar energia i una morterada en el viatge o fer tot el contrari i marxar tan lluny com sigui possible per oblidar durant unes setmanes el fervor del dia a dia. Davant d’aquesta disjuntiva, la líder d’ ERC a l’Ajuntament, Elisenda Alamany , ha tingut clara la tria: estiuejar a 2.500 km de distància de Barcelona. La republicana marxarà uns dies en família cap a Romania , un dels únics sis països de la Unió Europea que no fan servir l’euro. Diu que enguany ha triat aquesta destinació per envoltar-se de paratges de natura verge i també per descobrir indrets com el castell de Bran , mundialment conegut per ser la casa del comte Dràcula. De la mateixa sèrie… On estiueja Gerardo Pisarello, el futur líder de BComú a l’Ajuntament de Barcelona? Doncs esperem que no, que un servidor escriu amb molt de gust (i una mica d’enveja sana) sobre les vacances dels regidors, però no li vindria gens de gust interrompre les seves pròpies per haver d’explicar cap xuclada de sang! articles.body: El Col·legi d’Administradors de Finques de Barcelona-Lleida (CAFBL) reclama una reforma legal perquè les comunitats de propietaris puguin intervenir davant el jutjat en casos d’ocupacions que generen problemes greus de convivència. L’entitat alerta que hi ha casos en què les comunitats queden desprotegides quan el propietari de l’immoble no actua o ho fa amb retard. “Això no és anar en contra de la propietat, al contrari, és enfortir la propietat en benefici de la resta de veïns i garantir una convivència sana”, ha assegurat el president del CAFBL, Lorenzo Viñas . El col·legi planteja modificar l’article 553-40 del llibre cinquè del Codi civil de Catalunya perquè les comunitats de propietaris tinguin legitimació per intervenir judicialment en aquests casos, especialment quan el propietari és inactiu, es tracta d’una societat en concurs o no hi ha representació efectiva. També et pot interessar La Guàrdia Urbana intensifica la lluita contra les drogues: “No és una batalla fàcil” Jaume Planagumà Lola Santiago 2 minuts de lectura Protegir la seguretat del veïnat El CAFBL insisteix que l’objectiu de la reforma és protegir les persones que conviuen a l’edifici. Segons Viñas, les ocupacions conflictives poden provocar “ problemes de convivència gravíssims , danys a les instal·lacions comunes i una sensació d’inseguretat” entre els residents. L’entitat defensa que el debat no s’ha de centrar únicament en la titularitat de l’habitatge, sinó també en les conseqüències que aquestes situacions tenen sobre la resta del veïnat. Per això, reclama una resposta normativa més clara que permeti actuar quan la comunitat no disposa d’eines efectives. El cas que ha reobert el debat La reclamació del CAFBL arriba després que La Vanguardia i RAC1 s’hagin fet ressò de la situació que denuncien els veïns d’un edifici del carrer de Muntaner . Els residents asseguren que un suposat narcopís ha alterat greument la convivència de la finca i expliquen que fa mesos que conviuen amb un tràfec constant de persones, sorolls, baralles i episodis d’inseguretat. “ Estem en perill, ens fa molta por . Aquí hi viuen famílies amb nens petits i gent gran”, ha explicat una veïna a RAC1. Segons el seu relat, “hi ha gent entrant i sortint del pis constantment, crits, cops de porta, baralles… fins i tot un dia un home rondava per l’escala amb un ganivet”. L’Ajuntament confirma tres instàncies L’Ajuntament de Barcelona, per la seva banda, confirma que ha rebut tres instàncies relacionades amb aquest cas. Des del mes de gener, els veïns han alertat del trànsit constant de persones al pis, han demanat assessorament legal davant un possible desallotjament i també han denunciat l’acumulació de mobles al balcó de l’habitatge. El consistori assegura que ha atès tots els requeriments i que ha donat resposta a cadascun. Com a darrera actuació, la Guàrdia Urbana va denunciar aquest dimecres una de les persones que ocupaven el pis per un presumpte delicte d’apropiació indeguda. A més, l’Ajuntament confirma que, arran de les denúncies veïnals, la Guàrdia Urbana i els Mossos d’Esquadra han reforçat la vigilància de la zona i mantenen un seguiment de la situació. articles.body: Amb la forta calor de l’estiu és molt important mantenir-nos hidratats . Per això és molt positiu menjar fruites i verdures , que tenen un alt contingut d’aigua. D’altra banda, els nutricionistes aconsellen que, encara que durant les vacances tinguem més vida social i mengem més tapes i aperitius, s’ha d’ intentar mantenir una alimentació saludable i equilibrada, almenys en els àpats de casa. I, sobretot, beure aigua . Idees per menjar bé “La idea és que intentem mantenir l’estructura de l’alimentació saludable, introduir fruita, verdura i proteïnes de qualitat , com poden ser els ous durs, el peix, la carn, els llegums i el formatge fresc , i complementar-ho també amb hidrats . Podem fer cremes fredes, amanides molt variades de llegums, amb peix , també hi podem introduir pollastre , i fer un plat nutricionalment complet i equilibrat. Hem d’intentar allunyar-nos molt de fregits i plats precuinats”, recomana Elina Vidal, dietista i nutricionista de la Unitat d’Obesitat de l’Hospital del Vall d’Hebron. La síndria, la fruita que més agrada als catalans Ni les nectarines, ni els préssecs ni les prunes. Segons una enquesta d’Ametller Origen feta a 800 persones de tot Catalunya, la síndria és la fruita que més agrada : l’han triada un 39 % dels enquestats, seguida del meló (23 %) i la cirera (19 %). “La síndria és una de les fruites més buscades a botiga, quan comença la caloreta tothom en demana, és una fruita molt refrescant, amb un 95 % d’aigua , i és perfecta per refrescar-se, mantenir-se hidratat i combatre aquesta calor”, explica Ivan Barri, gerent de zona de Sants a Ametller Origen, establiment que cultiva les seves síndries al delta de l’Ebre , on tenen 30 hectàrees de conreus i tenen previst tancar la collita amb 2,5 milions de quilos. Per saber que una síndria està al punt “ha de tenir una taca groga , que vol dir que ha madurat bé als camps i que està al seu punt òptim de maduració . I, d’altra banda, si quan l’agafes i li dones uns copets la síndria ressona , això vol dir que està ben madura i plena d’aigua”, afegeix Barri. Evitar menjar només fruita La fruita aporta aigua, vitamines, fibres i antioxidants , molt positius per a la salut, però els nutricionistes aconsellen variar la fruita que mengem perquè cadascuna conté vitamines diferents . També recomanen menjar tres peces de fruita al dia però repartides durant la jornada i sense oblidar la resta d’aliments. “En els àpats principals, cal evitar només prendre fruita perquè si no també desplacem altres aliments i nutrients necessaris, com les hortalisses, les proteïnes i els hidrats, i intentar mantenir un bon equilibri nutricional “, explica Vidal. L’aigua ens hidrata, els refrescos, no I per acabar, però no menys important, no ens hem d’oblidar d’anar bevent aigua durant tot el dia , perquè, tot i que sembli que els refrescos i els sucs ens hidraten, realment no ho fan. “Donen una falsa sensació d’hidratació . Tot i que portin aigua, també tenen sucre, que altera l’equilibri fisiològic augmentant l’osmolaritat, i això fa que el cos en lloc d’hidratar-se hagi de compensar l’augment de l’osmolaritat per diluir la càrrega de sucres . A més, els refrescos ens provoquen un pic insulínic “, explica Vidal, que conclou: “L’ única beguda que ens hidrata és l’aigua “. I per què les fruites i les verdures ens hidraten si també tenen sucre? “La fruita i les hortalisses tenen sucre natural , però la seva fibra alenteix l’absorció d’aquest sucre . Per això el cos no la processa com un dolç o un refresc, sinó com un aliment complet i saludable que no genera pics de glucosa . El sucre de la fruita i la verdura no és comparable al sucre lliure dels sucs i refrescos “, explica Vidal. articles.body: El Barça podria protagonitzar una de les operacions més esbojarrades i sorprenents del mercat d’estiu, ja que, segons assegura Jijantes , Rodri serà jugador blaugrana . El migcampista madrileny semblava tenir el seu traspàs tancat amb el Reial Madrid per 60 milions d’euros , però en les darreres hores, el futbolista espanyol s’ha acabat decantant pel Barça . Ara mateix, el club blaugrana i el Manchester City encara han d’acordar les condicions de l’operació, però l’arribada de Rodri a Barcelona sembla inevitable, ja que a més el club mancunià vol respectar la decisió del jugador i facilitar la seva sortida al Barça . De fet, si alguna cosa no li ha faltat a Hansi Flick durant les darreres dues temporades han estat migcampistes i en aquest mercat no hi havia intenció de reforçar el centre del camp. Als seus 30 anys , Rodri aportarà experiència i qualitat a l’equip i farà que la baixa de llarga durada de Frenkie de Jong passi més desapercebuda i no afecti el joc. A més, el futbolista madrileny coneix bé la plantilla blaugrana, ja que en el Mundial ha compartit vestidor amb vuit jugadors del Barça . És un migcampista que sap el que és guanyar títols i que a Can Barça vol continuar conquistant les competicions.

articles.body: (ACN) Els Mossos d’Esquadra han detingut un home presumptament relacionat amb la mort violenta d’una persona a la via publica al districte de Nou Barris . Els fets s’han produït cap a les 12.40 h d’aquest dijous , quan efectius de la Guàrdia Urbana han avisat la policia catalana que havien trobat un home ferit al carrer de Casals, 41 , al barri de Verdum. Diverses patrulles dels Mossos s’han desplaçat al lloc dels fets, així com quatre ambulàncies del Sistema d’Emergències Mèdiques . Els equips sanitaris han traslladat l’home ferit , en estat molt greu, a un centre hospitalari, on finalment ha acabat morint . La Divisió d’Investigació Criminal (DIC) dels Mossos se n’ha fet càrrec per esclarir les circumstàncies dels fets. El cas està sota secret de les actuacions . Retiren una moto precintada D’altra banda, la grua municipal s’ha endut a mitja tarda una motocicleta aparcada al carrer d’Almansa i que podria estar relacionada amb el cas . Es trobava estacionada a pocs metres del domicili situat al carrer de Casals, 41, on agents de la científica i del cos han estat treballant. La moto s’ha precintat i ha estat custodiada pels Mossos fins a l’arribada del servei de recollida de vehicles. articles.body: L’escriptor i pedagog Carles Flo reflexiona al Viure bé ,  de Dani Clavera, sobre el poder de la concentració . Diu que quan deixem de jutjar-nos i centrem tota l’atenció en allò que fem l’esforç sembla desaparèixer. A partir d’exemples quotidians, explica com una concentració profunda pot millorar el rendiment, reduir el soroll mental i fer que una activitat flueixi amb naturalitat . La conversa és també un homenatge a Sesha , mestre de meditació i referent internacional del Vedanta Advaita , mort el novembre del 2025. Deixeble seu, Flo recorda els ensenyaments que van transformar la seva manera d’entendre l’atenció i la meditació, i comparteix algunes de les pràctiques amb què Sesha va acostar aquests coneixements a milers de persones . “L’atenció s’ha de sostenir en allò que mereix ser atès en el present” Carles Flo Tots els capítols en vídeo i àudio del  Viure bé   els pots trobar al  beteve.cat/viure-be  i a  Spotify .
